//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the PAGER component — the .pa-pager block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Pager.pager/1`, svelte `display/Pager.svelte`). Scoped to pa-pager ONLY: the sibling pa-load-more block (keen `load_more/1`, its own svelte component) is grouped with pager in the catalog but is a SEPARATE component and OUT OF SCOPE here. The pager has NO __item/__link/--active/--disabled vocabulary — the navigation controls are plain `pa-btn pa-btn--sm pa-btn--secondary` buttons (foreign block, not pager's), wrapped in pa-pager__controls. The pager's own surface is: alignment modifiers (--start/--center/--end), a flex __container, a __controls group, an __info group with a numeric __input and __text labels. Wrapper dumpers map neutral `props` to their own API, render SSR, and the core comparator diffs against `golden` after normalization. See ../README.md and badge.json/list.json for the model.

propsVocabulary.align: start|center|end — justify-content modifier. center is the SCSS default; the canonical snippet omits the class for centered. Both wrappers emit no class for their default-centered form (svelte align defaults to 'center' → no class; keen align defaults to nil → no class), and emit pa-pager--center only when align is set to 'center' explicitly. Scenarios exercise start/end (both wrappers agree); center the modifier is claimed by the feature's produces (axis-2) and left to the default no-class form in goldens.
propsVocabulary.showFirst: whether the First-page button renders. svelte: presence of the `onfirst` callback; keen: presence of the `on_first` event-name string. A truthy event name enables the button.
propsVocabulary.showLast: whether the Last-page button renders. svelte: `onlast` callback; keen: `on_last` event-name string.
propsVocabulary.firstLabel: First button text content. svelte `firstText`; keen `icon_first` (plain text, HTML-escaped). Fed identical text so button content matches.
propsVocabulary.previousLabel: Previous button text content. svelte `previousText`; keen `icon_previous`.
propsVocabulary.nextLabel: Next button text content. svelte `nextText`; keen `icon_next`.
propsVocabulary.lastLabel: Last button text content. svelte `lastText`; keen `icon_last`.
propsVocabulary.showInfo: boolean — whether the __info section renders (svelte `showInfo`, keen `show_info`).
propsVocabulary.showPageInput: boolean — whether the numeric page __input renders inside __info (svelte `showPageInput`, keen `show_page_input`).
propsVocabulary.page: current page value bound to the numeric __input (svelte `currentPage`, keen `page`).
propsVocabulary.totalPages: total page count — the input's max and the 'of N' label (svelte `totalPages`, keen `total_pages`).
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the root (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature.

goldenConventions: The pager root is a <div class="pa-pager">; an alignment modifier is present only for start/end. Navigation controls are plain pa-btn buttons (foreign block) inside pa-pager__controls — button text is fed identically to both wrappers via the *Label features so content matches. Scenarios pick a MIDDLE page (page between 1 and totalPages) so neither wrapper's disabled logic fires — keen derives disabled from page<=1 / page>=total_pages, svelte from disablePrevious/disableNext (left false), so a middle page yields NO disabled attr in either and a single golden fits. The __info section uses the canonical snippet shape (snippets/tables.html:388-392): a leading 'Page' __text, the numeric __input, then an 'of N' __text. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away by the comparator, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. Pager block modifiers: --start/--center/--end (alignment). Pager elements: __container/__controls/__info/__input/__text. The nav buttons carry pa-btn* classes (a FOREIGN block) not pager classes, so they're structural children with produces:null. `produces: null` = structural/native (no pa-pager class).

align.note: center is claimed here (axis-2) but rendered as the default no-class form; only start/end are exercised by goldens since both wrappers agree on those and omit the class for centered.

showFirst.note: structural — toggles the First button (a pa-btn child), no pager class

totalPages.note: total pages — input max + 'of N' label

deferred.//: The __info section elements are pager's OWN markup and blessed by the snippet (snippets/tables.html:388-392), but the two wrappers diverge on functional/i18n attrs that a single shared golden can't reconcile, so they're acknowledged out-of-scope for strict compare (prose, not a fixture ref). Svelte matches the snippet shape EXACTLY ('Page' __text → numeric __input → 'of N' __text) — verified by hand against svelte-pager.dump.json with showInfo+showPageInput on. Keen diverges on two unavoidable points: (1) its __input carries name="page", functionally REQUIRED for the LiveView phx-change form param (the static snippet has no name because it is not interactive); and (2) its labels come from keen's own i18n (t("pureAdmin.pagination.pages") = '/ N pages') rather than the snippet's literal 'Page'/'of N'. Both are legitimate per-wrapper concerns the harness's name-agnostic render diff isn't meant to force-converge. The controls surface (the strict-compared part) IS covered by the four scenarios below.
deferred.pa-pager__info: Info group — wrappers diverge on LiveView-required name attr + i18n label text; svelte matches the snippet, keen is functionally-divergent. Acknowledged out-of-scope.
deferred.pa-pager__input: Numeric page input inside __info — keen adds name="page" (LiveView phx-change param), the static snippet has none. Acknowledged out-of-scope.
deferred.pa-pager__text: Info text labels ('Page'/'of N') — keen renders its own i18n string. Acknowledged out-of-scope.

scenarios.name: prev-next-centered
scenarios.note: Canonical centered pager with prev/next (snippets/tables.html:382-394). Centered → no modifier class. page=5 (middle) so neither wrapper disables prev/next → no disabled attr; a single golden fits both. Exercises __container + __controls. Info section (__info/__input/__text) is deferred — see `deferred`.

scenarios.name: align-start-first-last
scenarios.note: Start-aligned, all four nav buttons in ONE pa-pager__controls group, info suppressed. page=5 (middle) so neither wrapper disables any button → no disabled attr. Exercises pa-pager--start + the First/Last buttons.

scenarios.name: align-end
scenarios.note: End-aligned, prev/next only, no info. Exercises pa-pager--end.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — extra class appended after pa-pager; token order normalized away.
